title: Pharma HIPAA Transcription POC - SOW & Commercial Slate
content:
Objective:
Provide a short, scoping SOW and commercial estimate for a 6-week POC with Acme Pharma to validate Redwood Private (on-prem/VPC) for de-identified medical transcription with HIPAA controls. Goal is to prove latency/throughput, data lifecycle controls, and model quality on clinical notes (radiology + pathology).

Background / context:
- Customer: Acme Pharma, clinical operations + regulatory (US).
- Use case: ingest recorded clinician dictation (30–120s audio) -> produce draft clinical notes, structured sections (HPI, Findings, Impression).
- Constraint: PHI present; must be processed in customer-controlled network with strict KMS/HSM integration and audit logs.
- Current ask: 6-week POC, final deliverable = accuracy report and deployment runbook + performance numbers.

Proposed high-level scope (phases):
1) Prep & compliance (week 0–1):
   - Kickoff workshop (on-site or virtual) to align on sample data, encryption requirements, acceptance criteria.
   - Host customer-run baseline security review and network runbook review.
   - Deliverable: POC security checklist, data transmission plan.
2) Build & deploy (week 1–3):
   - Provide Redwood Private image + deployment scripts for customer lab VPC (1 availability zone).
   - Integrate customer KMS for model artifacts and data-at-rest encryption.
   - Set up ingestion pipeline (s3-compatible endpoint) and transcription pipeline prototype (audio -> ASR -> LLM summarizer).
   - Deliverable: deployed POC stack, README, short runbook.
3) Test & iterate (week 3–5):
   - Run sample throughput tests: 10 concurrent streams at target 100 requests/minute, measure p50/p95 latency for ASR + LLM steps.
   - Perform quality evals on 200 annotated samples (customer-provided).
   - Run failure/fallback scenarios (network partition, GPU OOM).
   - Deliverable: test report, issues backlog, model tuning recommendations.
4) Wrap & handoff (week 5–6):
   - Final performance/cost report, recommended production architecture (Dedicated vs Private), and a 30-day follow-up plan.
   - Handover workshop + exec summary.
   - Deliverable: acceptance packet and production transition checklist.

Success criteria (examples):
- Functional: generated clinical notes match customer gold on section-level F1 >= 0.82 for HPI/Findings.
- Performance: median end-to-end latency (audio -> structured note) <= 3.5s per 10s audio equivalent for batch of 1; p95 within SLA for target throughput.
- Security: evidence of KMS-wrapped at-rest keys, audit logs configured and available to customer.

Technical approach notes: (working thoughts)
- ASR: recommend Tandem approach: run customer ASR (their preferred vendor) or open-source Whisper-derived model optimized inside Private. Offer two tracks: 1) customer ASR + Redwood summarizer; 2) integrated Redwood ASR -> Redwood LLM.
- LLM: start with 7B open-model quantized variant verified in our model catalog for this workload. If quality short, test 13B variant as fallback.
- Inference runtime config: 1x A10G-equivalent per 2 concurrent summarization workers (initial), enable prefix KV caching for follow-up edits.
- Data flow: customer audio stored in customer S3 -> Redwood agent in VPC pulls -> processes on dedicated GPU -> writes de-identified outputs to customer S3.

Compliance / data handling:
- All PHI stays inside customer VPC. Redwood control plane has no access to raw audio or outputs for this POC (customer-managed keys).
- Require HSM/KMS integration for model weights + telemetry sampling.
- Audit: syslog export to customer SIEM; include sample audit log format in deliverable.

Deliverables (what customer gets):
- POC deployment (container images + deployment scripts) and runbook.
- Performance & quality report with annotated sample analysis.
- Security checklist & audit samples.
- Ops playbook for production cutover (includes rollback/fallback).

Assumptions (explicit):
- Customer provides 200 labeled samples and a 2-node lab VPC with internet egress for initial pull of images.
- No custom model training included (only lightweight fine-tune/LLM prompt engineering).
- Logging/monitoring retention is limited to 14 days for POC unless customer opts-in.

High-level pricing (commercial slate - rough estimates):
- Professional services (total 6 weeks):
   - SE time: 3x SEs (30d total effort equivalent) @ $1,200/day blended -> $36,000
   - Security review and compliance lead (5d) -> $6,000
- Infra & licensing (POC duration 6 weeks):
   - Redwood Private license (POC) flat fee -> $12,000
   - 2 x A10G-equivalent reserved for 6 weeks (including infra ops) -> estimate $18,000
- Contingency / incident budget -> $3,000
- Total (not including travel): ~$75,000

Optional add-ons (not in base POC):
- On-site workshop day (travel + 1 day facilitation): $5,000
- Extended data retention / premium observability for POC: $2,500
- Small fine-tune on internal model weights (upto 5k gradient steps): T&M estimate $8,000

Pricing notes / negotiation levers (internal):
- Can discount Redwood Private POC fee if customer commits to 12-week Dedicated evaluation or a 1-year Reserved capacity contract.
- Reduce SE days by shifting some tasks to customer engineers (we provide runbook + remote pairing).

Risk register (short):
- Quality gap vs customer gold (mitigation: additional prompt engineering & test sets).
- Network policy complexity blocking KMS integration (mitigation: parallel plan to deploy using customer-provided temporary keys).
- Data availability: insufficient labeled samples (mitigation: use synthetic augmentation for initial evals).

Workshop agenda (kickoff, 90 min):
- 10m: intros & success criteria alignment
- 20m: customer data + security walkthrough (PII/PHI flow)
- 25m: proposed architecture & deployment options (Private vs Dedicated)
- 20m: acceptance tests and evaluation methodology
- 15m: next steps, owners, milestones

Open questions / decisions required (for sales/regulatory):
- Will Acme allow temporary access to de-identified telemetry for Redwood debug? (preferred = yes, limited scope)
- Which ASR vendor do they prefer? If they want vendor X, need integration time (+2–4 days).
- Do they require SOC2-type artifacts before any images are run in their environment?

Next steps / action items (owner):
- Share draft SOW + commercial slate with Sales (Samantha) -> target for first pass by 2024-08-26.
- Schedule kickoff workshop with Acme (Marco) -> propose 2024-09-02.
- Provision lab VPC checklist to Acme infra (Priya) -> collect by 2024-08-30.

Notes to self / internal:
- Keep POC license negotiation flexible; primary leverage = speed to production.
- Capture model telemetry sparingly (only perf metrics + failure traces) unless explicit permission.
- Align with privacy team on minimum redaction patterns for demo outputs.
